claims.claim: EDE shifts H0 upward by ~3 km/s/Mpc relative to LCDM under CMB+DESI fits
EDE prefers nonzero f_EDE ~ 0.09 ± 0.03 (CMB+DESI, no SH0ES)
claims.evidence: outputs/params_table.csv: f_EDE = 0.093 ± 0.031 -> ~3σ from zero in Bayesian best fit (paper Table I).

claims.claim: EDE only mildly improves chi^2 over LCDM in CMB+DESI fits without SH0ES
w0wa moves Omega_m UP and H0 DOWN whereas EDE moves Omega_m essentially unchanged and H0 UP
claims.evidence: Omega_m: LCDM 0.3037, EDE 0.2999, w0wa 0.353; H0: 68.12, 70.9, 63.5. See param_shift.png.

claims.claim: EDE leaves the BAO D_V/r_d residuals close to LCDM (acoustic-tension partially resolved through r_d shrinkage), whereas w0wa fits BAO/SNe by lowering H0 and requires a strong distance shift
claims.evidence: fig6_repro.png: EDE curve hugs LCDM in D_V/r_d panel; w0wa shows large negative excursion. r_d table: LCDM 145.4 Mpc, EDE 139.7 Mpc, w0wa 156.0 Mpc.

claims.claim: sigma_8 is shifted upward in EDE, exacerbating S_8 tension

limitations: We use the published Tables II/III best-fit means and 1σ marginals, treated as Gaussian: 2D ellipses ignore parameter correlations.
EDE distance evolution computed with phenomenological peaked-fluid background (n=3 axion-like); CMB perturbations not solved.
w0wa Δχ^2 not tabulated in paper_003; approximate literature values from DESI DR2 + CMB analyses are used as a comparator.
Sound horizon r_d for each model rescaled with H0_fid/H0_model heuristic, calibrated against the Planck 2018 r_d=147.05 Mpc anchor.
